name: What is the typical process for a kitchen layout redesign with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a kitchen layout redesign with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our integrated design-build process for a kitchen layout redesign begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and functional requirements. We then develop CAD-supported layouts, material selections, and a detailed plan. This is followed by permit coordination, construction, installation of custom cabinetry, countertops, and appliances, and a final walkthrough. This managed process ensures clear communication and a single point of coordination from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, CAD-supported design, material selection, permit coordination, construction, and final walkthrough, all managed by one team.
